content.text: {"core": "Flourishing lets a thing rest in its own good condition — tended, settled, enough as it stands. In Nurturing, it works on the making-things-thrive itself: the growing gets to arrive somewhere and hold. Overdone, the resting hardens into guarding — the settled state gets fenced and polished so hard nothing new is permitted to grow, and keeping the garden perfect starves the ground that fed it.", "sheetLine": "The garden is kept so perfectly that nothing is allowed to grow in it."}
